name: High-Protein Eggs & Toast
ingredients: Salt, black pepper, hot sauce (to taste)
preparation: Whisk 3 whole eggs and 1 cup liquid egg whites together in a bowl with salt, pepper, and a dash of hot sauce.
Scramble over medium-low heat in a non-stick skillet until cooked to desired preference.
Toast 2 slices of whole wheat bread.
Serve scrambled eggs alongside the toasted wheat bread.

name: High-Protein Pre-Workout Oatmeal
ingredients: 1.5 scoops Whey Protein Powder (Vanilla or Chocolate)
preparation: Combine 1 cup dry rolled oats with water in a microwave-safe bowl or pot.
Cook on high in microwave (1.5 - 2 minutes) or on stovetop until tender.
Let oats cool for about 60 seconds (prevents whey protein from clumping).
Stir in 1.5 scoops of whey protein powder until smooth and creamy. Top with cinnamon if desired.

name: High-Protein Butter Chicken & Rice
ingredients: 6 oz Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (sliced/diced)
preparation: Dice chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and cook in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat until cooked through.
Turn heat to low, add butter chicken sauce and non-fat Greek yogurt to stir and create a thick, high-protein sauce base.
Simmer for 3–5 minutes until heated thoroughly.
Serve over hot cooked Jasmine rice.

name: Lean Beef & Egg Rice Bowl
preparation: Brown 93/7 lean ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, seasoning with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
In a separate small pan, cook 1 whole egg (sunny-side up or scrambled).
Place cooked Jasmine rice into a bowl, top with seasoned ground beef and cooked egg.
Drizzle generously with brown mustard and hot sauce.

name: Chicken Tacos with Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 5 oz Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast
preparation: Season chicken breast with taco seasoning and cook in a skillet or oven until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Shred or slice cooked chicken into strips.
Warm 3 corn tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat for 30 seconds per side.
Fill tortillas with chicken and top with salsa; serve with Jasmine rice on the side.
